text:
carla: deploy-bot started rollout v2.4.1 -> region split US/EU/APAC. initial traffic: US 12%, EU 6%, APAC 2%. tagging ops for preflight capacity checks. pls confirm headroom and any pinned routes.
deploy-bot: [system] rollout initiated by carla at 2026-04-01T09:00:12Z. canary config: seq=phase-gate, timeout=30m, fallback=stable@v2.4.0.
sally: on it. running `ci capacity-check --region=us --min-headroom=20%` now. ETA 2m.
leo: quick note: APAC burst pool has scheduled maintenance window at 11:00 local, might reduce headroom. want to keep APAC at 2% until post-maint.
ops-oncall: saw that maintenance earlier. recommend gating APAC until we verify kv-cache warmup after canary.
carla: ok hold APAC. can we shift its 2% to EU temporarily? we prefer to keep US target steady for latency SLOs.
anika: EU can absorb +2% for the first 15m, but concurrent sessions over 1.2k will start queuing. current concurrency ~980.
sally: US capacity check green: GPU pool headroom 28%, concurrent CPU queue < 50. US good for rollout.
leo: EU capacity check results: headroom 14% (below our 20% guideline). we can accept +2% for 15m but set auto-throttle at 85% util.
maddie: proposing an explicit gating rule: if EU average latency > 350ms or util > 85% for 3 consecutive 1m samples, trigger rollback for EU only and re-route to US/stable.
carla: sounds good. deploy-bot, apply gating: eu throttle=85%, eu rollback-trigger=(latency>350ms && samples>=3) || util>85%.
deploy-bot: update applied. canary windows: US 12% steady, EU 8% (6+2), APAC 0% hold. policy: per-region rollback allowed; global fallback to stable on US failure.
ops-oncall: I'll monitor the dashboards and tag paging if thresholds hit. leaving a runbook note: `runbook/rollout-phase-gate.md` (internal) for oncall.
leo: running a quick smoke test against EU model endpoints: 10 requests, no errors, latencies avg=240ms.
sally: also ran token-level cost sanity: per-token cost stable within 3% delta vs baseline.
anika: reminder: pinned route /inference/classify must remain at stable for customers with data-region pinning. verified pinned routes: 3 still pinned to v2.4.0.
carla: good catch. keep pinned routes excluded from canary traffic.
maddie: thumbs up. timeline: observe for 30m, then increment APAC to 1% if EU remains <80% util and APAC maintenance completes.
leo: APAC maintenance confirmed complete at 09:25Z. but warming caches may take ~6m.
carla: after 30m, we plan: US -> 30%, EU -> 12%, APAC -> 4% if all checks pass. if any region triggers rollback, revert region-only and keep others.
sally: I'll push a short release note in #announcements once we clear 30m smoke: `v2.4.1 canary started - region gating in effect, pinned routes excluded, rollback rules enabled`.
maddie: logging decision: region-only rollback allowed, global fallback only for severe US outage. added to incident timeline.
deploy-bot: canary heartbeat: 10m elapsed, no rollback triggers. status: US OK, EU OK, APAC held.
ops-oncall: monitoring. setting 85% alert for EU and 90% for US as safety margin. will post updates in-thread.
carla: thanks team. callout: if EU util crosses 88% for >2m, we do immediate eject and re-route to US. otherwise hold and continue.
leo: noted. marking thread for handoff to ops for the remainder of the window. will update at 09:40Z with final numbers.
